jobs.description:
Job Information

Level of experience

Middle

Work Time

Full-time

Location

Romania

Work Type

Remote (Romania only)

What is the impact you want to make?

Unleash your biggest strengths, apply skills & knowledge, learn new things, connect with your peers and build your career with us!

Why rinf.tech?

#EngineerOfTheFuture, #PeopleofManyTalents

* At rinf.tech, you’ll encounter friendly people who are eager to explore and reinvent the world of technology.
* We encourage ideas - we like to share and learn from each other. We’re all in for curious & ambitious people.

#GrowOpportunities

* We continuously invest in developing core teams focused on technologies like Blockchain, AI, and IoT - www.rinf.tech/careers/core-blockchain-and-ai-teams/
* Our Technical Management team, possesses a robust technical background. Many of our team members have advanced to strategic roles through internal promotions.
* In a state of mutual willingness to share & grow, our RINFers commit to a minimum tenure of 2.5 years on a project.

#EngineeringExcellence

* Fail fast, learn fast: we experiment, we iterate, we know when to stop and we don't repeat the same mistakes.
* The right technology stack for the right problem: we don't force technology choices just because we know them; our focus is on solving problems, not on pushing predefined stacks.

#Innovation

* Adapta Robotics is a successful spin-off born through an R&D project within rinf.tech www.adaptarobotics.com/

Why do we do what we do?

We inspire one another to share our tech-works in this amazing and abundant world. So we became developers, innovators, thinkers, software builders, and hardware makers!

Our Vision!

Founded in 2006 with 650+ engineers & global presence (8 delivery centers in Europe & North America) we strive to become a leading East-European technology partner for growing organizations in need of digital transformation of their products and services!

What you’ll do

* Design, build and maintain features end to end in TypeScript/JavaScript (React front end, Node.js back end)
* Build and change GraphQL/REST APIs and the Node.js services that process manuscript data
* Write and run event consumers and producers (SNS/SQS, Kafka) and background jobs (BullMQ on Redis), with retries and duplicate-safe processing
* Model and change data in PostgreSQL, including schema migrations
* Connect to external screening services safely (timeouts, retries, fallbacks, error handling)
* Write unit and integration tests, and work with QA on end-to-end automation and test scenarios
* Add logging, metrics and tracing to your code, and use Grafana dashboards to investigate production issues
* Take part in technical refinement, estimation and lightweight design reviews
* Review code thoughtfully and help junior engineers through pairing and feedback
* Take part in production support and contribute to post-incident reviews

What you need to be successful

* 3–5 years of professional experience building production web applications in JavaScript/TypeScript
* Strong Node.js back-end experience (Express or similar) and solid React experience
* Hands-on experience designing and using GraphQL and/or REST APIs
* Good knowledge of relational databases (data modelling, SQL, migrations)
* Experience with asynchronous and event-driven processing (message queues, background jobs, retries)
* A strong testing habit: unit and integration tests by default
* Experience debugging production issues using logs and metrics
* Comfort working in an agile team and talking with product, QA and other engineering teams

Nice to have

* Experience with microservices, monorepos or modular monoliths
* AWS experience (SQS/SNS, S3, RDS, EKS) and Docker/Kubernetes
* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or configurable workflow systems
* Experience connecting to third-party APIs or document-processing pipelines
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or Grafana
* Interest in research integrity or academic publishing

What we offer you to be successful

* Flexible working environment, ability to work remotely or in a hybrid model, depending on your project requirements.
* Work with worldwide technology leaders - We partner and deliver technology to industry giants like Intel, NXP, Panasonic, Visteon, Carrefour, Windriver, Kardex, METRO Digital, and many others.
* Priority Plus Medical Subscription @Regina Maria (fully covered by the company)
* Mental Health Online Resources through the Hilio Wellbeing Platform
* Flexible benefits worth 1300 RON gross per month - you can choose the ones that suit your preference
* We have profit shares schemed that enable you to financially benefit from the new business you identify
* We have premium referral bonus for each successful recommendation you make - (500-1500 EUR NET based on seniority)
* Enjoy our vibrant offices in Romania's top IT hubs – Bucharest, Timisoara, Cluj, and Iasi, perfect for when you want to grab a coffee with your colleagues.
* Community – No man is an island, we stay connected through ongoing learning, project rotation, idea incubation, as well as through our Football Team, Townhalls, and Fun Thursday Office Day!

Next Steps for you!

* Apply
* CV screening
* HR Interview
* Technical Interview
* Offer presented by our CEO

Meet us!

Let's meet! We invite you to drop by anytime for a tour of our office, without any commitment.

##### **Join the** **#PeopleofManyTalents****#EngineerOfTheFuture**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
***Come Innovate Motion with Us***

As a Senior Software Engineer you will contribute to the development and continuous improvement of software applications used in manufacturing and operational environments. Working closely with senior developers and business stakeholders, you will support ongoing digitalization initiatives and contribute to system enhancements.

**Your responsibilities will be to:**

* Design, develop, and maintain industrial applications and services using C#/.NET, Angular, MSSQL, Redis, NATS, and related technologies
* Own solutions end-to-end, from requirement gathering and architecture through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production support
* Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and troubleshooting while remaining responsible for the correctness, security, performance, and maintainability of the solution
* Develop backend services, APIs, and machine-data integrations using technologies such as MQTT, NATS, OPC-UA, and Kepware
* Design and optimize databases, queries, stored procedures, caching strategies, and production data flows
* Build real-time dashboards, reporting, and monitoring solutions for production KPIs and operational data
* Design reliable systems that handle production realities such as high data volumes, concurrency, connectivity issues, duplicate messages, and out-of-order events
* Troubleshoot issues across frontend, backend, database, messaging, infrastructure, and machine integration layers
* Work directly with operators, engineers, and production teams to understand requirements, validate solutions, and improve existing systems
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, CI/CD, automated testing, and production diagnostics
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes using software and AI
* Travel abroad when required for business needs, including project implementation, technical support, collaboration

**Our Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably involving production systems, manufacturing, MES, industrial automation, or machine integration
* Strong C#/.NET skills, including ASP.NET Core, APIs, asynchronous programming, and background services
* Strong Angular and TypeScript development skills
* Strong MSSQL knowledge, including database design, indexing, query optimization, and stored procedures
* Understanding of distributed systems, messaging, caching, concurrency, and event-driven architectures
* Experience with technologies such as NATS, MQTT, OPC-UA, Kepware, or similar industrial integration platforms
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent tools
* Ability to review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and architectural fit
* Understanding of Git, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, logging, and production troubleshooting
* Strong problem-solving skills across software, database, integration, and manufacturing environments
* Ability to communicate effectively with software teams, controls engineers, process engineers, operators, and business stakeholders
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally

**What do we offer:**

* A truly international and multicultural work environment, in a company listed among top 500 industrial enterprises in Turkey
* Private health insurance which includes family members
* Local pension plan
* Various allowance benefits

* This is an **on-site position** at our Izmir Plant in the **Aegean Free Zone (ESBAS), Izmir, Türkiye. Remote or hybrid working is not available.**

***Come join our global, inclusive & diverse team***

Our purpose is to improve the quality of life of everyone we touch through our innovative motion systems. We are a truly global team bound together by our shared values. Our culture is built on the diversity, knowledge, skills, creativity, and talents that each employee brings to the company. Our people are our company’s most valuable asset. We are committed to providing an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where employees of different backgrounds feel valued and respected, regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity or religious background. We are committed to inspiring our employees to grow, act with ownership and find fulfilment and meaning in the work they do.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a freelance **Senior .NET Developer** to join a large-scale digital transformation project within the **Belgian energy sector**.

You will join an established Agile team working on secure **authentication, authorization and digital identity solutions** used across both modern and legacy applications. This is a hands-on development position combining **.NET/C#, Java, cloud, security and DevOps**.

The position is **full-time and hybrid**, with approximately **2 days per week onsite in the Brussels region**.

Your Responsibilities

* Develop, test and document software components and services using **C#/.NET and Java**.
* Build and integrate authentication and authorization solutions.
* Develop and document REST-based integrations and sample applications.
* Configure and extend components such as API gateways, reverse proxies, directory services and authorization engines.
* Work with **OAuth2, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SSO and MFA**.
* Contribute to front-end development using **Vue.js and Blazor**.
* Work with **LDAP and SQL Server**.
* Deploy and maintain applications in **Kubernetes / AKS** environments.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines, automation and configuration management.
* Troubleshoot technical and integration issues.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
* Document technical solutions, processes and architectures.
* Collaborate with developers, infrastructure teams and other technical stakeholders.

Must-Have Skills

* Strong professional experience with **C# and .NET**
* Professional **Java development experience**
* REST APIs, JSON and YAML
* JavaScript
* Vue.js and/or Blazor
* SQL Server and LDAP
* OAuth2 and OIDC
* Authentication & authorization concepts
* SSO, MFA, HTTPS, CORS and web security
* Kubernetes and/or AKS
* Git, CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Understanding of cryptographic concepts
* Good **English**, combined with **Dutch and/or French**

Nice to Have

* TypeScript, PowerShell or Bash
* React
* SAML2
* PKI, keystores and hash functions
* Experience with **Keycloak, ADFS, Okta, Ping Identity or Entra ID**
* Microservices architecture

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brussels

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Descripción de la empresa

  
  

Porque trabajar en Sopra Steria, también es sentir **Sopra Steria**.

Somos un reconocido líder europeo en consultoría, servicios digitales y desarrollo de software, con cerca de 56.000 empleados en casi 30 países y más de 4.000 en España.

Nos enfocamos en las personas, en su formación y desarrollo profesional, lo que nos impulsa a crecer y mejorar constantemente.

Tenemos pasión por lo digital y al igual que tú, buscamos la mejor de las aventuras. Queremos que tu día a día se convierta en la mejor de tus inspiraciones. Que aprendas, aportes, te diviertas, crezcas y que, sobre todo, disfrutes al máximo.

Si quieres formar parte de un equipo “**Great Place to Work**”, ¡Sigue leyendo!

**¿Qué buscamos?**

Estamos seleccionando un/a **Full Stack Developer** para incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico dentro del sector asegurador, participando en la evolución de aplicaciones corporativas críticas para negocio.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en desarrollo Full Stack, capaz de trabajar tanto en frontend como backend y con interés en participar en un entorno tecnológico moderno y colaborativo.

**Funciones**

* Desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones corporativas.
* Diseño e implementación de nuevas funcionalidades.
* Desarrollo frontend con Vue.js y TypeScript.
* Desarrollo backend con Node.js y .NET.
* Creación e integración de APIs REST.
* Resolución de incidencias y mantenimiento evolutivo.
* Participación en revisiones de código y definición de buenas prácticas.
* Trabajo en equipos Agile bajo metodología Scrum.

**Requisitos Imprescindibles**

* Experiencia como Full Stack Developer.
* Conocimientos sólidos en:
  + Vue.js
  + TypeScript
  + JavaScript
  + Node.js
  + C# / .NET
* Experiencia desarrollando APIs REST.
* Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales.
* Experiencia en entornos Agile.

Valorable

* Experiencia en plataformas BPM o Workflow.
* Conocimientos de K2.
* Experiencia con Docker, Kubernetes o CI/CD.
* Experiencia en sector seguros.
* Conocimientos de arquitecturas basadas en microservicios.

  
  

Información adicional

  
  

**¿Qué tenemos para ti?**

* Contrato indefinido y jornada completa
* 23 días de vacaciones
* Formación continua: competencias técnicas, transversales y de idiomas. Contamos con acceso a certificaciones, formaciones de los principales Partners Tecnológicos, plataformas online y ¡mucho más!
* Seguro de vida y de accidentes
* Posibilidad de acogerte a nuestra retribución flexible (seguro médico, cheques guarderías, transporte, comida y formación)
* Acceso a Privilege Club, donde encontrarás descuentos interesantes en las principales marcas
* Onboarding personalizado y detallado. Te acompañamos en todo momento para que te sientas #soprano desde el primer momento.
* Oficina con espacios reservados al ocio. ¡Trabajo y diversión unido!
* Compañerismo y buen ambiente, el poder de la unión lo tenemos presente.

  

Y lo más importante…Tienes la posibilidad de desarrollar tu carrera profesional con nosotros: Crearemos juntos un plan de carrera personalizado. Te formarás, marcaremos objetivos y llevaremos a cabo un seguimiento para asegurarnos de que lo conseguimos juntos. Escuchamos tus prioridades y luchamos por ellas.

¡Aquí tu voz importa! ¡Únete a nosotros y sé parte de algo más!

**The world is how we shape it**

En Sopra Steria estamos comprometidos con la creación de un entorno diverso e inclusivo, evaluando cada candidatura de forma objetiva, en base a sus competencias y experiencia. Creemos firmemente que la diversidad de experiencias y perspectivas es lo que impulsa nuestra innovación.

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.  

Job Summary\*\*
  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Developer to join our innovative team at Jabil, Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex software applications, contributing to the full software development lifecycle, and mentoring junior developers.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of scalable and robust software solutions.
* Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices and architectural patterns.
* Perform code reviews, provide constructive feedback, and ensure adherence to coding standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring high availability and performance of applications.
* Mentor and guide junior developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
* Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve development processes and product quality.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of software development processes and methodologies.
* Ensure compliance with security standards and data privacy regulations.

  
Job Qualifications\*\*

* Experience with agentic development (Claude Code, Github Copilot)
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 7+ years of professional experience in software development.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript (Node.js/React).
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
* Extensive experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Solid understanding of front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) if applicable to the role.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior team members.
* Experience in the manufacturing or supply chain industry is a plus.

BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in.

**Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

**Accessibility Accommodation**
===============================

If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always\_Accessible@Jabil.com with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to.
